mainEntity.name: When should I contact a real estate agent like Kelby Contreras for a Palm Beach relocation?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to contact a real estate agent like Kelby Contreras several months before your planned relocation to Palm Beach. Engaging early allows ample time for initial consultations to understand your needs, explore different neighborhoods, and set up property alerts. This preparation period ensures you are well-informed and prepared when suitable properties become available, especially in competitive markets.
